In 2004, people kept their attention on one screen for two and a half minutes.
Your brain isn't broken. It's been trained.
Every buzz, every red dot, every scroll is a tiny reward.
And your mind learned to chase the next one.
If you can't finish a page, a task, or even a thought, this is for you.
Every time you switch, you pay a price.
It can take over twenty minutes to fully get your focus back.
So here's how to take it back.
One. Phone in another room for one hour.
Two. Turn off every notification that isn't a person.
Three. One task. Twenty-five minutes. Nothing else.
At first, it will feel boring. Stay there.
Boredom is where your best ideas have been waiting.
Your attention is the most valuable thing you own.
Stop giving it away for free.
Put your phone in another room for one hour today.
